# Rule 2 - Keep Aurora's Song a mature space:
\n
Aurora's Song is an adult space. We expect maturity from our players. Making effort to treat each other with respect, and follow guidelines set forth by staff. Roleplay in this community may be difficult or discomforting, and our expectation is that you conduct yourself responsibly while respecting the consent and comfort of others.
You have no obligation to sit through an encounter you don't enjoy, and we will not punish players unless there is a direct rule break or consent breach.
